Section A, new, from the Night rain recipe. Rain, with orbits on the downbeat. A geodesic sphere is the centrepiece. The cosmos: the camera flies with the track, drawn in by builds and let go on drops, each section on the galaxy arm that suits it. The glow flies behind the planets. Lightning cracks on the stabs. Changes fade in. Colours: one hue against two. Pace: floating, pulsing once a bar.
